title: The new CI workflow's `develop` branch-filter assertion lacks the required same-PR isolating planted-violation
text: The new CI workflow's `develop` branch-filter assertion lacks the required same-PR isolating planted-violation proof; the evidence explicitly marks it unplanted and unverified. REVIEW.md requires demonstrated fail/pass evidence for every new assertion in an added CI job.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in c579f0f, 4 commits later. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
